JSON-LD script tag is stripped from output (security) but metadata may be extracted

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><title>Article</title><script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Article\",\"headline\":\"My Article\",\"author\":{\"@type\":\"Person\",\"name\":\"Jane Doe\"},\"datePublished\":\"2024-01-15\"}</script></head><body><h1>My Article</h1><p>Article body text.</p></body></html>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
